comparison_baseline.kind: family support scripts; no author-upstream baseline

method: Source-qualified AST inventory including private/nested definitions, existing-attribution and direct-literal screening, followed by primary-paper equation/table matching. Generic numerical controls and fixed regressions are not treated as empirical calibration. Inventory counts alone do not prove scientific correctness.
limits: Active WMAP7/CLASS helpers cite Viel, Vogel, Planck, Fixsen and Mangano where they adopt numerical parameters. Initial A_s is a normalization starting value; matching the CDM sigma8 target is explicit.
The cosmology controls do not reconstruct undocumented original CAMB settings. Vogel coefficients in the comparison remain an external alternative curve, not an adopted production change.
The compatibility manifest and all five gitlinks retain the recorded family set. These independent candidate documentation edits do not promote a mixed family.

cmb: Fixsen (2009), The Temperature of the Cosmic Microwave Background.
neutrinos: Mangano et al. (2005), Relic neutrino decoupling including flavour oscillations.
planck: Planck Collaboration (2020), Planck 2018 results. VI. Cosmological parameters, Table 2.
structure: Hiroshima, Ando & Ishiyama (2018), Modeling evolution of dark matter substructure and annihilation boost, Section II, Eqs. (5)-(9).
survival: Hayashi et al. (2003), The Structural Evolution of Substructure.
viel: Viel et al. (2005), Constraining warm dark matter candidates including sterile neutrinos and light gravitinos with WMAP and the Lyman-alpha forest, Eqs. (6)-(7).
vogel: Vogel & Abazajian (2023), Entering the Era of Measuring Sub-Galactic Dark Matter Structure: Accurate Transfer Functions for Axino, Gravitino & Sterile Neutrino Thermal Warm Dark Matter, Eqs. (7)-(9), Table II (v2).
wmap: Komatsu et al. (2011), Seven-Year Wilkinson Microwave Anisotropy Probe Observations: Cosmological Interpretation.
